sources.title: Codestral 25.08 official model card
sources.evidence: Exact codestral-2508/card version 25.08, Premier specialist, July 30 release, 128k context, text input/output, and explicit function calling, chat, FIM and structured-output features. No parameter counts or internal architecture are specified.

sources.title: Codestral 25.08 release announcement
sources.evidence: Dated July 30, 2025. Names the exact update and its FIM/chat/code-completion uses. Offers cloud, VPC and on-prem enterprise deployments; these are not a public open-weight release. Does not state parameter counts or dense/MoE structure.

sources.title: Codestral lifecycle and technical-documentation information
sources.evidence: Lists Codestral 2508 as an active specialized-model update released July 30, 2025, separate from 2405 and 2501. Technical-tab data explains why GPAI technical-documentation requirements do not apply to the Codestral family and provides no architecture/parameter disclosure.

sources.title: Official Mistral Codestral public checkpoint listing
sources.evidence: Official organization search returns only Codestral-22B-v0.1 and Mamba-Codestral-7B-v0.1. No public exact 25.08 checkpoint is listed. Original 22B and Mamba model specifications are not transferred.

sources.title: Mistral current reasoning support guide
sources.evidence: Documents adjustable reasoning for named Small, Medium, Large and GLM models; Codestral 2508 is not included. This omission does not establish an unconditional negative about its internal training or all deployment variants.

sources.title: Mistral legacy native reasoning guide
sources.evidence: Lists Magistral Small/Medium native-reasoning models and their serialized thinking outputs. Does not assign a native thinking mode to Codestral 2508.

sources.title: Later Devstral 2 official model card
sources.evidence: Later first-party coding-model card checked for retrospective comparison or disclosures about exact Codestral 2508; no Codestral reference or applicable parameter/architecture disclosure occurs. Devstral counts are not transferred.

sources.title: Later Mistral Large 3 official model card
sources.evidence: Later model card checked for exact Codestral comparison or retrospective disclosure; no Codestral reference occurs. Its own MoE architecture and counts do not establish the Codestral variant.

sources.title: OpenRouter exact Codestral 2508 route metadata
sources.evidence: Mistral-backed routes advertise 256000 context and tools/tool_choice but no reasoning parameter. The provider context differs from Mistral current card 128k. Gateway file-input support is not evidence of native vision/PDF encoding.

sources.title: Mistral FIM API reference
sources.evidence: Exact codestral-2508 response example generates text from code-prefix input. Dedicated FIM completion is distinct from tool calling, which is separately confirmed by the exact model card.

name.note: Exact release label, distinct from the original 24.05/22B checkpoint and January 25.01 release.

family.note: Developer calls Codestral a code-generation family; retains the catalog key.

release_date.note: Explicit announcement, exact card and lifecycle date agree; 25.08 is a version label, not evidence of an August release day.

open_weights.note: Premier commercial distribution with no public exact-release checkpoint found. Enterprise VPC/on-prem availability does not mean weights are publicly downloadable; do not describe it as API-only.

license.note: Descriptive classification for this Premier commercial release. The original 22B Non-Production License and Mamba Apache license are not assigned to 25.08.

parameters_b.note: No exact 25.08 total count disclosed in the reviewed primary release/card/legal evidence or later first-party coding/general-model cards. Primary-source research searches did not recover an exact-version technical report; no original 22B count is inferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-variant active count or counting convention disclosed. Do not equate active with total or assume a dense architecture.

architecture.note: Reviewed first-party material specifies coding/FIM behavior but no exact 25.08 dense/MoE/state-space architecture. Searches for exact-version technical and interpretability disclosures found no applicable first-party evidence. Neither original Codestral nor Codestral Mamba architecture is transferred.

context_window.note: Developer advertises 128k; 128000 is its decimal catalog normalization, not an independently verified exact native endpoint boundary. OpenRouter separately advertises exact256000 for its Mistral-backed route. Preserve this conflict without substituting the gateway value for the developer specification; endpoint capacity was not tested.

modalities.note: Exact developer card explicitly says text input/output. Document QnA and gateway file ingestion do not establish native image/audio/video input.

reasoning.note: No exact-release affirmative or explicit negative native-thinking declaration was recovered. Current/legacy reasoning support lists and exact route parameter lists do not include Codestral reasoning, but absence alone is not a categorical proof. Clear the baseline false; ordinary code reasoning/FIM is distinct from a native thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Exact model card explicitly includes function calling; gateway route supports tools and tool_choice. This is independent of the FIM feature.

description.value: Code model for fill-in-the-middle completion and code generation, with chat, function calling and structured outputs.
description.note: Uses directly documented features without benchmark superiority, architectural assumptions or an API-only claim.

patch.description: Code model for fill-in-the-middle completion and code generation, with chat, function calling and structured outputs.
patch.notes: Total parameters, active parameters and exact internal architecture are undisclosed in the reviewed primary sources; original 22B and Mamba specifications are not transferred. The current developer card lists 128k context (normalized to128000; exact native boundary unverified), while OpenRouter advertises a 256000-token Mistral-backed route. Text input/output and function calling are explicit. Dedicated native-thinking status remains unverified. Commercial VPC/on-prem deployment is offered, but no public exact-25.08 weights or redistributable weight license were found.

summary: Audited all 14 fields for exact Codestral 25.08. Confirmed July 30 release, Premier commercial distribution, text-only native modalities, function calling and current developer 128k context. Added proprietary license classification and factual description, and cleared unsupported categorical reasoning false. Counts and internal architecture remain undisclosed after exact-version primary and later-card searches; provider 256k context disagreement is documented.
